_comment: Standard base-image catalog shared by the runpod-runner and modal-runner subagents. Pick one with `image_preset` (modal spec) / `--image-preset` (runpod) and each runner resolves it to the right per-provider base. Override per-run with a free-form image (modal: spec.image (+ optional add_python); runpod: --image), which takes precedence over the preset. Add a preset by adding an entry below. modal.builder is either 'debian_slim' (Modal builds from scratch; python_version applies) or 'from_registry' (start from the docker image; add_python=null means the image already ships python). Deps from the spec (pip/apt/uv) are layered on top of whichever base is chosen.

cpu-base.description: Minimal CPU base; install deps on top via pip/uv. (Both runners' historical default.)
